dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-c", "print('Zephyr RTOS environment ready')"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt includes pinned versions for stability. Added lxml as dependency for doxmlparser. Dockerfile uses slim image for efficiency, copies requirements first for layer caching, and includes a simple startup command.
